decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the firm's established prescription line, likely carries a patented or improved formulation, and has its own web page, so investment and visible commitment argue for persisting.

The generic antidepressant is distant from the core and exposed to reimbursement-contract pressure, but approval and launch costs are already sunk and the product is presented on its own page, so management will attribute early weak results to market entry and keep it.

The combination antihypertensive is a multi-model line close to the established offer with substantial registration investment and prominent presentation, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.

The bone and joint supplement fits the announced strategy of building differentiated pharmacy-exclusive health products, so even though its web presence is only a mention, it is central enough to the stated direction to be kept.
